hunks.baseline: It was a Status Window I looked at more than ten times a day, but my mouth still split into a grin every time I saw it.
hunks.sol: I looked at my Status Window more than ten times a day, yet my mouth still split into a grin every time I saw it.

hunks.baseline: Who knew the four characters meaning “Peak Master” could make me this happy?
hunks.sol: Who knew those four characters—Peak Master—could make me this happy?

hunks.baseline: A heavy sphere suddenly popped into existence in midair. It was about the size of a bowling ball, its unpolished surface uneven and jagged, bulging out in every direction.
hunks.sol: A heavy sphere suddenly popped into existence in midair. It was about the size of a bowling ball, its unpolished surface uneven and jagged, bulging out every which way.

hunks.baseline: Supply followed demand. From the lowest-ranking martial artists to the heads of the family, most of them were sword users. As a result, both their martial arts and the quality of the weapons in the armory were far superior for swords than for spears.
hunks.sol: Supply follows demand. From the lowest-ranking martial artists up to the family’s leadership, most of them were sword users. As a result, both their martial arts and the quality of the weapons in the armory were far superior for swords than for spears.

hunks.baseline: How many times had my guts twisted whenever I swung an iron spear while leaving the [Unnamed Sword], made from Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron, at my side?
hunks.sol: How many times had my stomach burned whenever I swung an iron spear while the [Unnamed Sword], forged from Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron, sat idle?

hunks.baseline: Just as a famed sword only truly revealed its brilliance in the hands of a master, precious materials like Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron were no different.
hunks.sol: Just as a famed sword only truly reveals its brilliance in the hands of a master, precious materials like Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron were no different.

hunks.baseline: *Whatever it takes, I’m completing this Quest before I leave.*
hunks.sol: *Whatever it takes, I’m clearing this Quest.*

hunks.baseline: “Our youngest broke through the wall! He reached the Peak realm!”
hunks.sol: “Waaah! Our youngest broke through the wall! He reached the Peak realm!”

hunks.baseline: “Your useless older brother couldn’t even look after you properly, and yet you grew up this well all on your own. Sniff.”
hunks.sol: “Your good-for-nothing older brother couldn’t even look after you properly, and you went and pulled this off all on your own. Sniff.”

hunks.baseline: “You’re not planning to write ‘Jin Taekyung has become a Peak Master’ on a gigantic banner like last time, are you?”
hunks.sol: “You’re not planning to write ‘I’ve become a Peak Master’ on some gigantic banner like last time, are you?”

hunks.baseline: Before I could answer, Hyuk Mujin, who had been sitting there quietly with his shoulders hunched, suddenly cut in with a baffled expression.
hunks.sol: Before I could answer, Hyuk Mujin, who had been sitting there quietly, deflated, suddenly cut in with a baffled expression.

hunks.baseline: “Could you tell me about his skill?”
I answered him kindly despite the expression of shock and confusion on his face.
hunks.sol: To the guy asking with a mix of shock and confusion on his face, I answered kindly.

hunks.baseline: “Whew. Good thing I didn’t give it to you back then.”
hunks.sol: “Whew. That could have ended badly if I’d given it to you back then.”
